q: The cold drink needed some _____ to make it refreshing on such a hot day.
translation: 这么热的天，冷饮需要加些冰才能变得清爽。

q: We stopped at a small shop to buy _____ on a very hot afternoon.
translation: 在一个非常炎热的下午，我们在一家小店停下来买冰淇淋。

q: She had a brilliant _____ for the new marketing campaign next month.
translation: 她为下个月的营销活动想出了一个绝妙的主意。

q: This quiet location is _____ for opening a small family bookstore.
translation: 这个安静的地点非常适合开一家小型家庭书店。

q: The two dresses looked completely _____ even though they were from different brands.
translation: 这两条裙子看起来完全一样，尽管它们来自不同的品牌。

q: The witness was able to _____ the suspect from a photo lineup at the police station.
translation: 目击者能够从警察局的照片队列中辨认出嫌疑人。

q: The thief tried to steal the old man's _____ to get a bank loan illegally.
translation: 小偷试图窃取老人的身份以非法获得银行贷款。

q: The phrase 'break a leg' is an English _____ that actually means good luck.
translation: 短语'break a leg'是一个英语习语，实际上意思是祝好运。

q: She completely _____ my warnings and went ahead with the risky plan anyway.
translation: 她完全无视我的警告，还是继续执行了那个危险的计划。

q: She felt too _____ to go to work, so she stayed in bed and rested all day.
translation: 她感觉病得太重没法去上班，所以整天躺在床上休息。

q: It is _____ to drive a car without a valid license in most countries around the world.
translation: 在大多数国家，没有有效驾照驾驶汽车是违法的。

q: His sudden _____ prevented him from attending the important business meeting.
translation: 他突然生病，使他无法参加那次重要的商务会议。

q: The teacher used a simple diagram to _____ the complex process for the students.
translation: 老师用一张简单的图表向学生说明这个复杂的过程。

q: The company wants to improve its public _____ through better customer service.
translation: 公司希望通过更好的客户服务来改善其公众形象。

q: It is hard to _____ what daily life would be like on a distant planet.
translation: 很难想象在遥远星球上的日常生活会是什么样子。

q: Please call me _____ if you notice any problems with the computer system.
translation: 如果你发现计算机系统有任何问题，请立即给我打电话。

q: The new government policy will have a significant _____ on small local businesses.
translation: 新的政府政策将对当地小型企业产生重大影响。

q: I did not mean to _____ that you were wrong; I was just asking honest questions.
translation: 我不是暗示你错了，我只是问了一些诚实的问题。

q: The store _____ handmade goods from several countries in Southeast Asia.
translation: 这家商店从东南亚几个国家进口手工制品。

q: It is _____ to drink enough water every day for good health and energy.
translation: 每天喝足够的水对健康和精力很重要。

q: It is _____ to finish this huge project by tomorrow without extra help.
translation: 没有额外的帮助，要在明天之前完成这个庞大的项目是不可能的。

q: The guests were deeply _____ by the hotel's warm and friendly service.
translation: 客人们对酒店热情友好的服务印象深刻。

q: He made a good _____ on the interviewer by arriving early and dressing neatly.
translation: 他通过早到和穿着整洁给面试官留下了好印象。

q: Her English skills have _____ greatly since she moved to London last year.
translation: 自从去年搬到伦敦以来，她的英语技能有了很大提高。

q: There is only one _____ of space between the desk and the bedroom wall.
translation: 书桌和卧室墙之间只有一英寸的空间。

q: A strange _____ happened at the train station that made everyone nervous.
translation: 火车站发生了一件奇怪的事件，让所有人都紧张起来。

q: The price does not _____ tax, so you will need to pay a little extra.
translation: 这个价格不包括税费，所以你需要额外支付一点。

q: She earns a good monthly _____ from her online teaching business.
translation: 她从她的在线教学业务中获得了不错的月收入。

q: The company's profits have _____ by twenty percent since the new manager arrived.
translation: 自从新经理上任以来，公司的利润增加了百分之二十。

q: The view from the top of the mountain was absolutely _____ and breathtaking.
translation: 山顶的景色绝对令人难以置信，令人叹为观止。

q: The weather during our vacation was _____ terrible from the first day to the last.
translation: 我们度假期间的天气确实糟糕，从第一天到最后一天都是如此。

q: She moved out of her parents' house at eighteen to become financially _____.
translation: 她十八岁时搬出了父母家，以实现经济独立。

q: The survey results clearly _____ that most local people support the new policy.
translation: 调查结果清楚地表明，大多数当地民众支持这项新政策。

q: Each _____ student has different strengths and weaknesses in learning.
translation: 每个学生在学习中都有不同的优势和劣势。

q: The tourism _____ brings millions of dollars to the local economy every year.
translation: 旅游业每年为当地经济带来数百万美元的收入。

q: The doctor treated the bacterial _____ with a strong dose of antibiotics.
translation: 医生用大剂量抗生素治疗了这种细菌感染。

q: From his silence and body language, we can _____ that he does not agree with us.
translation: 从他的沉默和肢体语言中，我们可以推断出他不同意我们的观点。

q: His parents heavily _____ his final decision to study medicine at university.
translation: 他的父母对他最终在大学学习医学的决定产生了很大影响。

q: She is one of the most _____ writers in modern American literature today.
translation: 她是当今现代美国文学中最有影响力的作家之一。

q: Please read the _____ carefully before you fill out the application form.
translation: 在填写申请表之前，请仔细阅读这些信息。

q: My _____ reaction was to say no, but I changed my mind after thinking about it.
translation: 我最初的反应是拒绝，但考虑之后我改变了主意。

q: The company launched a new _____ to reduce plastic waste in the office.

q: He suffered a serious leg _____ during the football match last Saturday.
translation: 上周六的足球比赛中，他的腿部受了重伤。

q: The old city is surrounded by an _____ ring of modern office buildings.

q: The lawyer proved that his client was completely _____ of the crime.
translation: 律师证明他的当事人完全无罪。

q: The smartphone was one of the greatest _____ of the twenty-first century.
translation: 智能手机是二十一世纪最伟大的创新之一。

q: We truly value your _____ on how to improve our customer service experience.
translation: 我们非常重视您对如何改善客户服务体验的意见。

q: If you have any questions about the tour, please _____ at the front desk.
translation: 如果您对旅游有任何问题，请在前台询问。

q: A small flying _____ crawled across the window in the warm morning sunlight.
translation: 一只小飞虫在温暖的晨光中爬过窗户。

q: The research gave us a valuable _____ into how young people shop online.
translation: 这项研究让我们对年轻人如何网购有了宝贵的见解。

q: She _____ on paying for the dinner even though I offered to split the bill.
translation: 尽管我提出分摊账单，她仍坚持要付晚餐的钱。

q: The old building passed a safety _____ without any serious problems.
translation: 这座老建筑通过了安全检查，没有任何严重问题。

q: The documentary was truly _____ and made me want to volunteer in my community.
translation: 这部纪录片真的很鼓舞人心，让我想在我的社区做志愿者。

q: For _____, many people now work from home instead of going to the office.
translation: 例如，许多人现在在家工作而不是去办公室。

q: The coffee mix provides an _____ hot drink with just a cup of water.
translation: 这种咖啡混合物只需一杯水就能提供即时的热饮。

q: We could not find a taxi, so we took the bus _____ and arrived on time.
translation: 我们找不到出租车，所以改乘公交车，准时到达了。

q: The research _____ was founded in nineteen sixty-five to study climate change.
translation: 该研究所成立于1965年，旨在研究气候变化。

q: The university is the oldest educational _____ in the entire country.
translation: 这所大学是全国最古老的教育机构。

q: Please follow the _____ carefully when you assemble the new furniture.
translation: 组装新家具时，请仔细遵循说明书。

q: The violin is a musical _____ that requires years of dedicated practice.
translation: 小提琴是一种需要多年专注练习的乐器。

q: It is wise to buy travel _____ before you go abroad for your vacation.
translation: 在国外度假之前购买旅行保险是明智的。

q: The new system was successfully _____ into the existing company platform.
translation: 新系统被成功地整合到现有的公司平台中。

q: A person of _____ always tells the truth even when it is difficult to do so.
translation: 一个正直的人即使在困难时也会说真话。

q: She is an _____ student who always asks thoughtful and deep questions.
translation: 她是一个聪明的学生，总是提出深思熟虑的问题。

q: Do you _____ to stay here for the whole summer or just for a short week?
translation: 你打算在这里度过整个夏天还是仅仅一周？

q: The summer heat was so _____ that we had to stay indoors all afternoon.

q: It was not my _____ to hurt your feelings; I am truly sorry for what I said.
translation: 我无意伤害你的感情；我对我所说的话深表歉意。

q: The friendly _____ between the two groups was filmed for the documentary.
translation: 两组人之间的友好互动被拍摄下来用于纪录片。

q: He has a strong _____ in learning how to play the guitar very well.
translation: 他对学习如何弹好吉他有着浓厚的兴趣。

q: The history book was so _____ that I could not stop reading it at night.
translation: 这本历史书太有趣了，我晚上读得停不下来。

q: The company is dealing with an _____ problem in its management team.
translation: 公司正在处理管理团队内部的某个问题。

q: The airport handles flights from over fifty _____ destinations around the world.

translation: 你能解释这个旧标志的意思吗？它是用当地方言写的。

translation: 老师的迅速干预阻止了打架进一步恶化。

q: She has a job _____ tomorrow morning with a large technology company.

q: Let me _____ you to my colleague, who works in the marketing department.
translation: 让我把你介绍给我的同事，他在市场部工作。

q: The scientist hopes to _____ a new medicine that can cure this rare disease.
translation: 这位科学家希望发明一种可以治疗这种罕见疾病的新药。

q: The printing press was one of the most important _____ in human history.
translation: 印刷机是人类历史上最重要的发明之一。

q: The police are _____ the cause of the accident very thoroughly and carefully.
translation: 警方正在非常彻底和仔细地调查事故的原因。

translation: 买房对大多数工薪家庭来说是一项重大的财务投资。

translation: 我们决定邀请邻居下周六晚上来吃晚饭。

q: The new project is _____ over twenty people from different departments.

q: She _____ her clothes every Sunday before the start of the work week.
translation: 她每周日都会熨烫衣服，为工作周做准备。

q: The small tropical _____ is only accessible by boat during the summer months.
translation: 这座热带小岛仅在夏季几个月可乘船到达。

q: The local government _____ a public warning about the approaching storm.
translation: 当地政府发布了关于即将来临的暴风雨的公开警告。

q: Each _____ on the shopping list must be checked before we leave the store.
translation: 购物清单上的每件物品必须在我们离开商店前检查。
